title: Iteration 6: Flag & Finish
goal: Last bug! The flag fires too early. Fix collision. Then... see what you built.
mascot_lines: We're at the very last step — the flag at the end!
When the hero touches the flag, the win screen plays.
We make this moment feel BIG — confetti, sounds, a fun message.
Players remember endings, so we polish this part the most.

tier2.rephrase: Pick the fix that makes the flag fire only on touch.

tier3.nudge: The flag needs proper hitbox-on-hitbox checking — not just 'walked past'.

sandbox.hint: Ask: 'why does my flag fire when I just walk past it?'
